notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control by any method.
When that creature enters the battlefield, Reaper King triggers, destroying that creature.
Resolve Atla Palani's trigger, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 until Kozilek enters the battlefield then dies, or until you choose to end the loop by destroying an opponent's permanent.
If Kozilek dies, it and Atla Palani trigger.
Resolve Kozilek's trigger, shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Continue from step 3.
